description: Introducing the Baseus K01B Bluetooth Wireless Tri-Mode Keyboard, the perfect accessory for your Notebook, Pad, PC, Tablet or Laptop. With 84 keys, this mini slim keyboard is designed for dual system use and features a 2.4G silent keyboard. Its Bluetooth wireless connectivity allows for easy pairing with your device, while the tri-mode feature allows you to switch between three devices with ease. The keyboard is also designed with a sleek and slim profile, making it easy to carry around. Whether you're typing up a report or playing your favorite game, the Baseus K01B keyboard is the perfect addition to your setup.
